verses: Ahl kitab kay kafir aur mushrik log jab tak kay unn kay pass zahir daleel na aajaye baaz rehney walay na thay (woh daleel yeh thi kay)
Allah Taalaa ka aik rasool jo pak saheefay parhay
Jin mein sahih aur durust ehkaam hun
Ahl kitab apney pass zahir daleel aajaney kay baad hi (ikhtilaf mein parr ker) mutafarriq hogaye

Unhen uss kay siwa koi hukum nahi diya gaya kay sirf Allah ki ibadat keren ussi kay liye deen ko khalis rakhen. Ibrahim hanif kay deen per aur namaz ko qaeem rakhen aur zakat detay rahen yehi hai deen seedhi millat ka
Be-shak jo log ahl kitab mein kafir huye aur mushrikeen sab dozakh ki aag mein (jayen gay) jahan woh hamesha (hamesha) rahen gay. Yeh log bad-tareen khalaeeq hain
Be-shak jo log eman laye aur nek amal kiye yeh log behtareen khalaeeq hain

Unn ka badla unn kay rab kay pass hameshgi wali jannaten hain jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay. Allah Taalaa unn say razi hua aur yeh uss say razi huye. Yeh hai uss kay liye jo apney perwerdigar say daray
